title: The box model
summary: Understand content, padding, border and margin, and set each one.

quiz.q: Put the layers of the box model in order from the inside out.
quiz.explain: The content is surrounded by padding, then the border, then the outer margin.

quiz.q: Which layer creates space **inside** the border, between the border and the text?
quiz.explain: Padding is inside the border and shows the element's background. Margin is outside the border and is always transparent.

quiz.q: What is the computed `padding-left` in px?
quiz.explain: With two values, the first is top and bottom and the second is left and right.

quiz.q: Give the box a 2px solid black border.
quiz.explain: The border shorthand takes a width, a style and a colour. Without a style such as `solid`, no border shows.

quiz.q: In the shorthand `margin: 5px 10px 15px 20px`, which side gets 20px?
quiz.explain: Four values go clockwise from the top: top, right, bottom, left.

exercise.task:
Give the `.card` its box. Work in `index.html`.

- `padding` of 20px on all sides.
- A `border` of 2px solid (any colour).
- A `margin-bottom` of 30px.
- Give `.card h2` a `margin-top` of 0.
hints: There are four layers: content, padding, border and margin. You will set the last three.
Write a `.card` rule with `padding`, `border` and `margin-bottom`, and a separate `.card h2` rule.

checks.name: The card has 20px padding on top
The card has 20px padding on the left
The border style is solid
checks.hint: A border needs a style: use solid.

checks.name: The card has a 30px bottom margin
The card heading has no top margin
